content.text: {"id": "mm6613a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "overall, MSM had a rate of primary and secondary syphilis 106.0 times the rate among men who reported sex with women only"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "State-specific rates among MSM ranged from 73.1 per 100,000 population (Alaska) to 748.3 (North Carolina)"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the overall rate of primary and secondary syphilis among all men (aged ≥18 years) in the United States in 2015 was 17.5 per 100,000"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In every state, the incidence of reported syphilis among MSM was higher than the incidence among men who have sex with women only"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "with state-specific rate ratios ranging from 39.2 (Minnesota) to 342.1 (Hawaii)"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "primary and secondary syphilis case counts reported in 2015 to the National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "This final number was then scaled to equal 3.9% of the adult male population, based on a prior national MSM estimate"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "To optimize stability of the estimates, the analysis was limited to the 44 states"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "cases in men with unknown sex of sex partner were excluded from this analysis"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["analytic_depth", "study_design"]}
